tools.purpose: Measure Shannon entropy per section and report the layout facts a self-unpacking stub leaves behind (RWX section, entry in the last section, no ASLR).
tools.expect: one row per section with flags and entropy, then heuristic judgement lines and an optional sections.json

notes: Read-only. Entropy is computed over the raw bytes of each section. The judgement lines are measurements, not a packer identification; attribution needs the stub constants.
